Class outline:
- 45 minutes power flow 
- Free time sauna & plunge
 
What to expect:
- Dynamic powerful movement paired with the breath to challenge your mind and body 
- extreme temperature changes in the sauna & cold plunge

Class outline:
- 30 minutes of deep power breathing with breath retentions
- 3 minute cold plunge 
- Free time sauna & plunge 
 
What to expect:
- energetic powerful breathing 
- feelings of euphoria, tingles, light headedness, temperature changes 
- loud music 
- mental and physical challenge in the cold plunge
 
* This practice can be quite intense, so whilst we will guide you through, we encourage you to listen to your own body and adjust to the session accordingly.

What to expect:
- A movement class where strength and mobility intersect. Here you will learn a diverse repertoire of physical practises based on primal movements which bullet-proof joints and allow you to move with powerful grace across the floor.
 
Class structure:
- 45 mins of natural movement patterns
- 3 min guided cold plunge
- 40 mins free time sauna/plunge

Class outline:
- 45 minutes of deep power breathing with breath retentions
- 3 minute cold plunge 
- Free time sauna & plunge 
 
What to expect:
- energetic powerful breathing 
- feelings of euphoria, tingles, light headedness, temperature changes 
- loud music 
- mental and physical challenge in the cold plunge
 
* This practice can be quite intense, so whilst we will guide you through, we encourage you to listen to your own body and adjust to the session accordingly.

On Saturday 21 June, Inner Studio transforms into an intimate performance space for a unique live music experience like no other.

Melbourne’s own Tony Soprano Band will perform a special set of downtempo electronica—blending synths, drum machines, and live bass into a dreamy, immersive soundscape designed to accompany your sauna and plunge session.

Each ticket includes:

- 90 minutes of sauna, cold plunge, and relaxation time

- A 50 minute live performance from Tony Soprano Band (filmed for future release)

Whether you’re a long time Inner Studio member or attending for the first time, this is a one-night-only opportunity to experience live music in a whole new way.
